recommendations.title: Create a Fox ESS product page with specs and datasheets
recommendations.details: Write a dedicated product page for Fox ESS models (start with CQ7) that includes: key technical specifications (capacity, nominal voltage, usable kWh, charge/discharge power, round-trip efficiency, chemistry, IP rating, operating temp), physical dimensions and weight, warranty terms, typical use cases (outdoor large systems), compatibility notes with common inverters/brands we use, and downloadable PDF datasheet and certificate scans. Include simple ‘who is this for’ guidance (e.g., best for large outdoor battery installations) and a short FAQ about procurement and lead times.

recommendations.title: Optimize existing technical comparison to include Fox ESS configuration notes
recommendations.details: Refresh the technical comparison page to expand the Fox ESS mention into a short subsection describing recommended configurations (e.g., typical capacities, when to choose CQ7 for outdoor systems), plus notes on control modes supported by Fox ESS (backup, self-consumption, peak shaving) and interoperability caveats. Add example system builds (panels + inverter + Fox ESS) with estimated performance and a link to pricing/contact for a quote.
suggestedSections: Why we choose Fox ESS for large outdoor systems

recommendations.title: Create a Fox ESS commissioning & settings how-to article
recommendations.details: Produce a practical how-to guide mapping Optimera Energi control strategies (self-use, spot price charging, peak shaving, backup) to the Fox ESS settings and portal steps. Include screenshots or annotated UI steps, wiring checklist, common alarms and remedies, and guidance on firmware updates and integration with popular inverters and EV chargers. Keep language customer- and installer-friendly and include a short checklist for the post-install handover to the homeowner.
